name: markspace-browser-tests
description: Browser layout audit for Markspace. Run with make layout from the repository root.

auditNotes.playwright-core: lib/pw.mjs loads playwright-core from PLAYWRIGHT_CORE, then test/browser/node_modules, then any ~/.npm/_npx/<hash>/node_modules with version 1.63.x. Install it with: npm install --prefix test/browser playwright-core@1.63.0
auditNotes.chromium: The newest chromium-NNNN build in ~/.cache/ms-playwright, or in PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH.
auditNotes.fake AI server: fakeai.py in this directory, standard library only. FAKEAI_SERVER may name another script that takes the port as its last argument.
auditNotes.python: python3 runs the fake AI server and the Word count example plugin from sdk/example.
auditNotes.sqlite3 and ffmpeg: Optional. sqlite3 adds 30 days of AI usage rows and paused and failed jobs. ffmpeg makes the seed video.
